command:
set -Eeuo pipefail

echo "== step: create system user =="
sudo -n useradd --system --no-create-home --shell /usr/sbin/nologin inventorysvc
id inventorysvc

echo "== step: write unit file =="
sudo -n tee /etc/systemd/system/inventory-worker.service > /dev/null <<'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Inventory Worker (os-comparison-worker)
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=inventorysvc
Group=inventorysvc
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker
Restart=on-failure
NoNewPrivileges=yes

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
EOF

echo "== step: reload, enable, start =="
sudo -n systemctl daemon-reload
sudo -n systemctl enable --now inventory-worker

echo "== step: verify =="
sleep 1
sudo -n systemctl is-active inventory-worker
sudo -n systemctl is-enabled inventory-worker
sudo -n systemctl status inventory-worker --no-pager
echo "-- process owner --"
